subject.title: refactor(macos): move PortGuardian state to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw support the proposed one-way PortGuardian SQLite cutover, where older JSON-only macOS app copies are excluded from the migrated host-global state directory?
rationale: The branch deliberately trades downgrade interoperability for a single durable SQLite owner across concurrent app copies; that compatibility contract cannot be selected from code review alone.

options.title: Accept the SQLite cutover
options.body: Approve the documented one-way mixed-version behavior after final-head signed migration and recovery evidence is attached.

options.title: Preserve downgrade interoperability
options.body: Pause this branch and redesign the transition around an explicitly supported upgrade/downgrade contract before replacing the JSON owner.

options.title: Defer the migration
options.body: Keep the existing ledger until the prerequisite stack and macOS compatibility policy can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Accept the SQLite cutover
recommendation.body: Approve the documented one-way mixed-version behavior after final-head signed migration and recovery evidence is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body explicitly requests a decision on this contract and this contributor authored the complete migration stack.
